summary_en: Sekisui House Co., Ltd. will launch a tender offer for all outstanding shares and warrants of Gifu Landscape Architect Co., Ltd. at 2,770 yen per share and 397,800 yen per warrant, with a tender period from November 16, 2026 to January 13, 2027. The target company's board approved the offer and recommended shareholders to participate, intending to make it a wholly owned subsidiary and delist from the stock exchange.
title_en: Notice of Opinion Supporting and Recommendation to Participate in Tender Offer by Sekisui House Co., Ltd., a Related Company, for Shares and Warrants of Our Company
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, Gifu Landscape Architect Co., Ltd. announced that its board of directors has approved an opinion supporting a tender offer by Sekisui House Co., Ltd. to acquire all outstanding shares and warrants of the company. The offer price is set at 2,770 yen per share and 397,800 yen per warrant, with a tender period of 37 business days from November 16, 2026 to January 13, 2027. The minimum number of shares to be acquired is 1,529,300, representing approximately 46.6 percent of outstanding shares (excluding treasury shares) on a fully diluted basis including 120 remaining warrants.

Secretarial House already holds 655,500 shares, or 20 percent of the company's outstanding shares on a fully diluted basis. The two companies maintain capital, personnel, and transactional relationships; Gifu Landscape Architect is classified as an equity-method affiliate of Sekisui House. The tender offer is intended to result in the complete acquisition and subsequent delisting of Gifu Landscape Architect from the stock exchange.
